sources.claim: 45 servers, 353 tools; attack success rates >60%, highest 72%

sources.title: MCP Security Vulnerabilities

sources.title: Claude Code Headless Mode
sources.claim: claude -p --bare skips all config discovery; recommended for CI; will become default for -p

sources.title: Claude Code Enterprise Costs
sources.claim: ~$13/dev/active day, $150–250/dev/month; agent teams use ~7× tokens; 90th pct <$30/day
